# Little Bloom Photography

> Family, maternity, newborn and couples photography based in Barrie, Ontario,
> Canada. Natural light, unposed, lifestyle sessions. Run by Ayi, a photographer
> with over 20 years behind the camera.

Little Bloom Photography serves Barrie with no travel fee, and travels across
Simcoe County and the surrounding area (Innisfil, Oro-Medonte, Springwater,
Angus, Alliston, Bradford, Orillia, Wasaga Beach, Collingwood, Midland) for a
travel fee that depends on distance and session type.

Sessions are by appointment and booked by email at
hello@littlebloomphotography.com, with a reply within one business day. There is
no phone line; this is an email-only business.

## Sessions and pricing

- The Budding Bloom: $200 CAD, 30-minute photo session
- The Flourishing Bloom: $300 CAD, 1-hour photo session

Both packages include unlimited shots, time-permitting outfit changes, full
access to every edited high-resolution image with no cap on the number of
photos, an online gallery, and applicable taxes. Studio access is available as
an optional add-on, subject to studio availability. Prints are available through
a professional lab.

- [Bumps & Beginnings](https://www.littlebloomphotography.com/gallery/bumps-and-beginnings): Maternity portraits.
- [Little Blooms](https://www.littlebloomphotography.com/gallery/little-blooms): Babies and kids.
- [Love & Connections](https://www.littlebloomphotography.com/gallery/love-and-connections): Couples and families.
- [Personal Portraits](https://www.littlebloomphotography.com/gallery/personal-portraits): Solo portraits.
